settings_controls_ios:
• Swipe left or right to move.
• Tap the left or right half of the screen.
• Use the left and right arrow keys when a keyboard is connected.
• With a controller, the D-pad and left stick move by default; you can remap buttons in Controller settings.
settings_controls_macos:
• Use the left and right arrow keys on the keyboard to move.
• Click the left or right half of the window with the trackpad or mouse.
• Press the space bar to pause or resume.
• With a controller, the D-pad and left stick move by default; you can remap buttons in Controller settings.
settings_controls_tvos:
• Swipe left or right on the Siri Remote to move.
• Press the play button to select.
• With a controller, you can remap button bindings in Controller settings.
settings_controls_watchos:
• Rotate the Digital Crown up to move right and down to move left.
• Tap the left side of the screen to move left and the right side to move right.
• Swipe left to move left and right to move right.

tutorial_audio_mode_description_arpeggio: Plays safe lanes one note after another from left to right.
tutorial_audio_mode_description_chord: Plays all safe lanes at once as a chord.
tutorial_audio_mode_description_lane_pul: Plays short pulses in lane slots; an active pulse marks a safe lane.
tutorial_audio_move_style_description_ha: Plays a success haptic for a safe lane and a move haptic for an unsafe lane.
tutorial_audio_move_style_description_la: Plays lane confirmation followed by a success or fail tone.
Plays only the destination lane note, as you move left or right, so you can match it with the audio cue.
tutorial_audio_move_style_description_sa: Plays only a success or fail tone.
tutorial_speed_warning_description_annou: Announces the speed increase with VoiceOver.
tutorial_speed_warning_description_hapti: Plays a warning haptic before the speed increase.
tutorial_speed_warning_description_none: Does not play any speed-increase warning.
tutorial_speed_warning_description_sound: Plays a short three-note ascending warning chirp.
tutorial_voiceover_intro: RetroRapid! is a 3-lane racing game. Move left or right between the three positions. We play sounds to indicate which lanes are safe, and you must quickly move into a safe lane to overtake cars and avoid crashing.
